title: How to Make Your Caregiver Profile on Find CDS Caregivers (Missouri CDS)
short_title: How to make your caregiver profile on findcdscaregivers.com
description: Want caregiving work close to home in southwest Missouri? Here's how to make your free caregiver profile on findcdscaregivers.com, step by step: join the list, state requirements, about you, your photo, an optional hello video, your days and times, and what families see. Screens shown use example data.

parts.head: How to make your caregiver profile
parts.text: Want caregiving work close to home, paid fifteen to sixteen dollars an hour? I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Here's how to make your free caregiver profile on findcdscaregivers.com, so families near you can ask to meet you.

parts.head: Join our caregiver list
parts.text: First, join our caregiver list. It takes about two minutes, and it doesn't commit you to anything. You can say no to any family.

parts.head: Where and when you can work
parts.sub: Counties, how far you'll drive, rough availability
parts.text: You'll tap the counties you'd work in, how far you'll drive, and the times that could work. It's just a rough idea, not a schedule. And if there's already someone you'd be caring for, say so. That usually means we can move much faster.

parts.head: A short checklist
parts.sub: Five steps, at your own pace
parts.text: Then you go straight to your profile. It's a short checklist, and you can do it at your own pace.

parts.head: State requirements
parts.sub: Register with the Family Care Safety Registry
parts.text: Step one is the state requirements. You register with the Family Care Safety Registry, and sign the screening authorization. The state fee is sixteen dollars, and you only register once.

parts.head: Tell families about you
parts.sub: Write it the way you'd say it
parts.text: Step two: about you. Write it the way you'd say it. What you enjoy about caregiving, your experience, even if it's caring for family, and your hobbies. Families read this before they ask to meet you.

parts.head: Add a friendly photo
parts.text: Step three: a friendly, recent photo of just you, with your face clearly visible. A window with soft light works great.

parts.head: A short hello video
parts.text: If you'd like, add a short hello video, thirty to sixty seconds, from your phone. You answer four short questions, one at a time, and you can preview it, retake it, or remove it later.

parts.head: Your days and times
parts.text: Step four: your days and times. Update them any time, and families see when you last confirmed them.

parts.head: See what families see
parts.sub: Preview it, then give your OK
parts.text: Step five: see exactly what families will see. Our office reviews your profile, and once your state screening is complete, families we invite can find you.

parts.head: A family would like to meet you
parts.sub: Say yes, or not this time
parts.text: When a family would like to meet you, you'll get a request. Say yes, or not this time. Meeting doesn't commit you to anything.

parts.head: Pause or remove it any time
parts.sub: We never ask for your Social Security number online
parts.text: Need a break? You can pause introductions, or remove your listing any time. And we never ask for your Social Security number online.
Start your free profile at findcdscaregivers.com, or call us at 417-218-2888. I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Thanks for watching.
